text: In Lean 4's kernel, Prop is a sort that differs from Type in that:
choices: Prop is a universe with no universe polymorphism
proof terms in Prop are definitionally equal (proof irrelevance holds)
Prop is always the bottom of the universe hierarchy
explanation: Lean 4 has proof irrelevance for Prop: any two proofs p q: P are definitionally equal when P: Prop. This allows large eliminations from Type into Prop but not vice versa.
